151  private static double clampDeadband(double deadband) {
152    if (Double.isNaN(deadband)) {
153      return 0.0;
154    }
155    return Math.clamp(deadband, 0.0, MAX_DEADBAND);
156  }

1466  @Override
1467  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
1468    table.log("LeftX", getLeftX());
1469    table.log("LeftY", getLeftY());
1470    table.log("RightX", getRightX());
1471    table.log("RightY", getRightY());
1472    table.log("LeftTrigger", getLeftTrigger());
1473    table.log("RightTrigger", getRightTrigger());
1474    table.log("A", getAButton());
1475    table.log("B", getBButton());
1476    table.log("X", getXButton());
1477    table.log("Y", getYButton());
1478    table.log("Menu", getMenuButton());
1479    table.log("Steam", getSteamButton());
1480    table.log("View", getViewButton());
1481    table.log("LeftStick", getLeftStickButton());
1482    table.log("RightStick", getRightStickButton());
1483    table.log("LeftBumper", getLeftBumperButton());
1484    table.log("RightBumper", getRightBumperButton());
1485    table.log("DpadUp", getDpadUpButton());
1486    table.log("DpadDown", getDpadDownButton());
1487    table.log("DpadLeft", getDpadLeftButton());
1488    table.log("DpadRight", getDpadRightButton());
1489    table.log("QAM", getQAMButton());
1490    table.log("RightPaddle1", getRightPaddle1Button());
1491    table.log("LeftPaddle1", getLeftPaddle1Button());
1492    table.log("RightPaddle2", getRightPaddle2Button());
1493    table.log("LeftPaddle2", getLeftPaddle2Button());
